title: Crestline Credit Card Credit Limit Increases and Product Changes
content:
Credit limit increases on a Crestline Credit Card are requested by the cardholder and decided by Northgate Bank.

## When an increase may be requested

All of the following must hold:

1. the account has been open for at least the product's required months, counted as calendar months from the open date;
2. at least the product's waiting months have passed since the last limit change;
3. the account has 0 days past due; and
4. no late fee was charged on the last 6 statements.

The new limit is at most the current limit plus the product's largest increase percentage, and never above the product's highest credit limit.

Hypothetical figures: a current limit of 2,000 USD with a 50% largest increase on a product whose highest limit is 2,500 USD can rise at most to 2,500 USD.

## Product upgrade

An account whose run of consecutive on-time statements reaches the product's upgrade figure is moved to the product's upgrade product. The purchase APR becomes the upgrade product's purchase APR, and the credit limit is kept, or raised to the upgrade product's lowest credit limit when it is lower. A product whose upgrade product is none is never moved. Promotional plans already on the account keep their terms through a product change.

| Current limit compared with the upgrade product's lowest limit | Limit after the upgrade |
|---|---|
| at or above it | unchanged |
| below it | raised to that lowest limit |
